5703-the-lord-of-death-and-the-queen-of-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "Occasionally it breaks through, anyhow, in the form of lightning. Now, in order to control that current, and prevent it from turning this machine, and us, into ashes, all we do is to pass the juice through a cylinder of highly compressed air, fixed in this wall. By varying the pressure and dampness within the cylinder, we can regulate the flow."

arxiv-2109-07487.title: NIHAO-LG: the uniqueness of Local Group dwarf galaxies 2022 NIHAO-LG: the uniqueness of Local Group dwarf galaxies – B
arxiv-2109-07487.creator: Nikhil Arora, Andrea V. Macciò, Stéphane Courteau, Tobias Buck, Noam I. Libeskind, Jenny G. Sorce, Chris B. Brook, Yehuda Hoffman Gustavo Yepes, Edoardo Carlesi, Connor Stone
arxiv-2109-07487.description: Abstract Recent observational and theoretical studies of the Local Group (LG) dwarf galaxies have highlighted their unique star-formation history, stellar metallicity, gas content, and kinematics. We investigate the commonality of these features by comparing constrained LG and field central dwarf halo simulations in the Numerical Investigation of a Hundred Astrophysical Objects (NIHAO) project.

arxiv-2205-04962.title: Glassy Dynamics in Polyalcohols: Intermolecular Simplicity vs. Intramolecular Complexity
arxiv-2205-04962.creator: Till Böhmer, Jan Philipp Gabriel, Rolf Zeißler, Timo Richter, Thomas Blochowicz
arxiv-2205-04962.description: Abstract Using depolarized light scattering, we have recently shown that structural relaxation in a broad range of supercooled liquids follows, to good approximation, a generic line shape with high-frequency power law ω − 1 / 2 \omega^{-1/2} . We now continue this study by investigating a systematic series of polyalcohols (PAs), frequently used as model-systems in glass-science, i.a.

arxiv-2208-09869.title: Flexible evaluation of surrogacy in Bayesian adaptive platform studies
arxiv-2208-09869.creator: Michael C Sachs, Erin E Gabriel, Alessio Crippa, Michael J Daniels
arxiv-2208-09869.description: Abstract Trial level surrogates are useful tools for improving the speed and cost effectiveness of trials, but surrogates that have not been properly evaluated can cause misleading results. The evaluation procedure is often contextual and depends on the type of trial setting.

arxiv-2209-05763.title: The density property for vector bundles
arxiv-2209-05763.creator: Riccardo Ugolini, Jörg Winkelmann
arxiv-2209-05763.description: Abstract . We prove that holomorphic vector bundles over Stein manifolds with the density property also satisfy the density property, provided that the total space is holomorphically flexible. We apply this result to provide a new class of Stein manifolds with the density property. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary: 32M18; Secondary: 32Q28, 32M25 1.

arxiv-2304-03488.title: This article is part of an OCNMP Special Issue
arxiv-2304-03488.creator: in Memory of Professor Decio Levi
arxiv-2304-03488.description: Abstract Finite-difference schemes for the one-dimensional shallow water equations in the presence of a magnetic field for various bottom topographies are constructed. Based on the results of the group classification recently carried out by the authors, finite-difference analogues of the conservation laws of the original differential model are obtained.

arxiv-2401-13937.title: Self-supervised Video Object Segmentation with Distillation Learning of Deformable Attention
arxiv-2401-13937.creator: Quang-Trung Truong, Duc Thanh Nguyen, Binh-Son Hua, Sai-Kit Yeung
arxiv-2401-13937.description: Abstract Video object segmentation is a fundamental research problem in computer vision. Recent techniques have often applied attention mechanism to object representation learning from video sequences. However, due to temporal changes in the video data, attention maps may not well align with the objects of interest across video frames, causing accumulated errors in long-term video processing.

arxiv-2402-18647.title: Rank Lower Bounds on Non-local Quantum Computation
arxiv-2402-18647.creator: Vahid R. Asadi, Eric Culf, Alex May
arxiv-2402-18647.description: Abstract A non-local quantum computation (NLQC) replaces an interaction between two quantum systems with a single simultaneous round of communication and shared entanglement. We study two classes of NLQC, f f -routing and f f -BB84, which are of relevance to classical information theoretic cryptography and quantum position-verification.

arxiv-2408-07865.title: Capturing the Complexity of Human Strategic Decision-Making with Machine Learning
arxiv-2408-07865.creator: Jian-Qiao Zhu 1, Joshua C. Peterson 2, Benjamin Enke 3, Thomas L. Griffiths 1,4
arxiv-2408-07865.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jian-Qiao Zhu 1, Joshua C. Peterson 2, Benjamin Enke 3, Thomas L. Griffiths 1,4. Understanding how people behave in strategic settings–where they make decisions based on their expectations about the behavior of others–is a long-standing problem in the behavioral sciences. We conduct the largest study to date of strategic decision-making in the context of initial play in two-player matrix games, analyzing over 90,000 human decisions across more than 2,400 procedurally generated games that span a much wider space than previous datasets.

arxiv-2510-00112.title: JWST-discovered AGN: evidence for heavy obscuration in the type-2 sample from the first stacked X-ray detection
arxiv-2510-00112.creator: A. Comastri, G. Lanzuisi, F. Vito, S. Marchesi, M. Brusa, R. Gilli, I. Juodžbalis R. Maiolino G. Mazzolari G. Risaliti, J. Scholtz, C. Vignali

arxiv-2512-07766.title: Formalized Hopfield Networks and Boltzmann Machines
arxiv-2512-07766.creator: Matteo Cipollina †, Michail Karatarakis †, Freek Wiedijk
arxiv-2512-07766.description: Abstract Neural networks are widely used, yet their analysis and verification remain challenging. In this work, we present a Lean 4 formalization of neural networks, covering both deterministic and stochastic models. We first formalize Hopfield networks, recurrent networks that store patterns as stable states.

britannica-1911-fantasia.title: Fantasia (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-fantasia.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-fantasia.description: Article 'Fantasia' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 10), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. from Greek, φαίνειν , to show), a name in music sometimes loosely used for a composition which has little structural form, and appears to be an improvization; and also for a combination or medley of familiar airs connected together with original passages of more or less brilliance. The word, however, was originally applied to more formal compositions, based on the madrigal, for several instruments.

pmc-11653988.title: The relationship between serum CTRP-5, C3a/desArg, and complement-C3 levels and hypothyroidism in women with polycystic ovary syndrome
pmc-11653988.creator: Fatima Abdul-ameer, Itlal Jummha AbudlRasool AlAsadi, Asieh Hosseini, Elham Bahreini
pmc-11653988.description: IntroductionMany patients with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) also experience thyroid disorders. There is a notable similarity in energy metabolism among PCOS, C1q/tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-related proteins (CTRP-5)deficiency, C3a/desArg (also known as acylation-stimulating protein (ASP)) deficiency, and hypothyroidism. This study aimed to investigate the relationship between serum levels of these factors and hypothyroidism in patients with PCOS.

pmc-12391520.title: The influence of hydraulic hose length on dynamic pressure waveforms including wave phenomena
pmc-12391520.creator: Michał Stosiak, Paweł Bury, Mykola Karpenko
pmc-12391520.description: This paper investigates dynamic pressure waveforms in hydraulic hoses. Steel hoses of various lengths were tested, with the frequency of pressure waves varied for a fixed hose length, and pulsating flow was generated by a positive displacement pump. At certain hose lengths, outlet pressure pulsations were amplified while inlet pulsations were attenuated, demonstrating hydraulic resonance.

pmc-12646242.title: Inflammatory optic neuritis and scleritis following commencement of semaglutide: a case report
pmc-12646242.creator: Clare B Maher, Brad Guo, Anthony A Dunlop
pmc-12646242.description: Given the documented increased risk of non-arteritic ischaemic optic neuropathy (NAION), the widespread use of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) has raised concerns regarding their ophthalmic safety. This study presents a unique case of inflammatory optic neuritis and scleritis in a 43-year-old female one month following commencement of semaglutide.

pmc-12649236.title: The Impact of a Structured Outpatient Parenteral Antimicrobial Therapy (OPAT) Programme on Quality of Care, Optimisation of Antimicrobial Use, and Healthcare Costs: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-12649236.creator: Irene G Manders, Darya Comello, Dennis Souverein, Sjoerd Euser, Bjorn L Herpers, Judith Vetten, Jayant S Kalpoe, Marco Goeijenbier, Steven F L van Lelyveld, Timo Juhani Lajunen, Mark Sullman
pmc-12649236.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: In 2022, Spaarne Gasthuis hospital implemented an outpatient parenteral antimicrobial therapy (OPAT) programme, including mandatory infectious disease (ID) specialist assessment and integrated structured workflow, aiming to improve quality of care, optimize antimicrobial use, and reduce healthcare costs. Our objective was to evaluate the impact of the OPAT programme on patient outcomes (IV duration, clinical response, adverse clinical outcomes, timely peripherally inserted central catheter (PICC) removal), antimicrobial stewardship parameters, and healthcare costs.

pmc-12711649.title: Understanding the Metabolic Fingerprint of Muscle Aging
pmc-12711649.creator: Liang-Kung Chen
pmc-12711649.description: ctive study examining the association between plasma metabolites and incident sarcopenia in 33,797 participants from the UK Biobank [2]. The study identified 38 plasma metabolites significantly associated with sarcopenia risk and evaluated their incremental predictive value beyond conventional risk factors. Nevertheless, several methodological issues warrant further consideration. First, the discordance between baseline and incident sarcopenia ascertainment may introduce diagnostic bias.

pmc-13157217.title: Protocol to stain phagocytic macrophages and assess phagocytosis function in phagocytic cells
pmc-13157217.creator: Mostafa Changaei, Seyed Adnan Kashfi, Sara Soudi, Mohammad Adel Ghiass, Seyed Mahmoud Hashemi
pmc-13157217.description: SUMMARYThe yeast phagocytosis assay serves as a foundational tool for directly visualizing and quantifying a phagocyte’s ability to bind and internalize foreign targets. Here, we present a protocol for analyzing phagocytosis in mouse peritoneal macrophages. We describe steps for yeast staining, phagocytosis of stained yeast, hematoxylin staining of macrophages, and light microscopy imaging.

pmc-13211881.title: Diagnostic Yield of Abdominal Wall Fat Pad Biopsy for Systemic Amyloidosis in a Low-Prevalence Referral Cohort
pmc-13211881.creator: João Teixeira, Diogo Teixeira, André Coelho, José Carlos Cardoso
pmc-13211881.description: IntroductionSystemic amyloidosis is a rare disorder characterized by extracellular amyloid deposition in tissues, leading to variable organ dysfunction. Abdominal wall fat pad biopsy is widely used as a minimally invasive diagnostic approach, yet its sensitivity varies according to population and technique.

pmc-13221352.title: Integrative Taxonomy and Life Stage Associations in Nectopsyche fuscomaculata Flint, 1983 (Trichoptera: Leptoceridae)
pmc-13221352.creator: Pedro Bonfá-Neto, Felipe Ribeiro Pereira Sarmento, Rayner Paresqui Constantino, Roberta Paresque, Frederico Falcão Salles
pmc-13221352.description: Semaphoronts are entities that carry the characteristics of individuals at different periods over time, essential for understanding species in various biological areas. In the long-horned caddisfly genus Nectopsyche Müller, 1879 (Trichoptera: Leptoceridae), there is a significant lack of knowledge about semaphoronts, especially in South America.

pmc-13278981.title: Decoding type 5 diabetes using spatial omics: microarchitectural and molecular mechanisms of malnutrition-associated diabetes
pmc-13278981.creator: Anusha Komati, Kiranmai Mandava, Ajay Anand
pmc-13278981.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This review advocates for the formal recognition of Type 5 Diabetes Mellitus, a distinct, neglected form of non-autoimmune, lean diabetes predominantly affecting low-income and middle-income populations with a history of early-life malnutrition. Characterized by impaired insulin secretion amid preserved insulin sensitivity, this phenotype exhibits unique microarchitectural alterations within pancreatic islets and is strongly linked to malnutrition-induced epigenetic reprogramming and gut microbiota dysbiosis.

pmc-13371453.creator: Candido Faiela, Troy D Moon, Mohsin Sidat, Esperança Sevene
pmc-13371453.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAntibiotics are commonly overused to treat upper respiratory tract infections (URTIs) in HIV-infected adults in primary healthcare settings, even though viruses cause most URTIs. Therefore, a de-implementation of unnecessary antibiotic prescribing for URTIs was implemented in these settings.
